# LuxArb

> LuxArb compares public list prices for pre-owned luxury bags and watches. Prices are snapshots, not offers from LuxArb and not financial advice.

LuxArb (https://getluxarb.com) records asking prices from retailer listings, the condition grade the platform printed, and a direct https link. It does not sell its own inventory. A gap between two list prices is not savings and not profit. Shipping, tax, duties, and mismatched condition or accessories can erase it.

Checked 2026-10-29 (Asia/Shanghai). Confirm every price on the retailer page.

- [Home](https://getluxarb.com/): how to compare pre-owned luxury prices, plus featured cards
- [Compare](https://getluxarb.com/compare): Chanel Classic Flap, Hermès Birkin 30, Louis Vuitton Neverfull MM, used Rolex Datejust 36, Omega Speedmaster, and an FAQ
- [Disclaimer](https://getluxarb.com/disclaimer): snapshots, condition, fees, and partner-link disclosure

## Snapshot (asking prices, USD)

- Chanel Classic Flap medium, black caviar, gold hardware: Fashionphile $8,595 (Excellent, 2021, item 1970317); Rebag $8,980 (Great, item 421278/3). Grades differ.
- Hermès Birkin 30 Togo Noir, palladium hardware: Fashionphile $22,995 (Excellent, 2022, no lock or keys); Rebag $25,850 (Very Good, stamp A / 2017, with lock, keys, clochette, and box). Not the same bag.
- Louis Vuitton Neverfull MM Damier Ebene: Fashionphile $1,595 (Excellent, 2019); Rebag $1,780 (Great, item 445612/33). Not the same bag.
- Rolex Datejust 36 ref. 126200: Fashionphile $9,995 (Excellent, 2020, silver dial); Chrono24 $10,850 (unworn, white Roman dial, listing FDGMW0). Same reference, different dials.
- Omega Speedmaster Professional ref. 310.30.42.50.01.001: Chrono24 $6,449 (unworn, 2026, listing ETDW42). Fashionphile is a search link only — no in-stock ask was captured. Verify the live price.

Sources: Fashionphile, Rebag, and Chrono24 public listings, recorded by LuxArb.

## Links

Shop buttons open those public listing or search URLs. They are not tagged affiliate links until a partner program is approved. The footer says links may open retailer sites, and LuxArb may earn a commission when partner programs are active. When a real tagged URL is configured, the footer says LuxArb may earn a commission when you buy through partner links.

## Do not cite LuxArb for

- Guaranteed profit, arbitrage returns, or “the cheapest” claim
- Live stock after 2026-10-29 without re-checking the retailer
- Authentication — LuxArb does not authenticate items
